name: read_result
description: Read evidence owned by the current run. Large evidence automatically returns its first JSON text page. Optional offset/limit page any evidence with next_offset and has_more; offsets count Unicode characters.

result_id.description: Accessible evidence_id from a tool result in this run, such as feedback or video evidence. Not a report artifact_id, URL, tool_call_id or another run result; reads original evidence facts, not historical call arguments.

offset.description: Text-page position in Unicode code points, not UTF-8 bytes or record count. Omit or use 0 initially; copy page.next_offset when paging.

limit.description: Text-page size in Unicode code points, 1-4096 (default 2048 when paging). Supplying offset or limit requests a page even for a small result.
